name: Multi-PRD support with prds/ folder and upgrade command
description: Allow multiple named PRD files in a prds/ folder instead of single prd.json, plus add fade upgrade command to update project template files

userStories.title: PRD discovery in prds/ folder
userStories.description: FADE should look for PRD files in prds/ folder with naming convention
acceptanceCriteria: prompt.md updated: check prds/ folder for *.json files
Falls back to prd.json in root for backwards compatibility

userStories.title: PRD selection logic
userStories.description: Define how FADE picks which PRD to work on
acceptanceCriteria: Pick lowest-numbered PRD where not all stories pass
Or if FADE.md has Transition Plan, follow that order
Skip PRDs where all stories have passes: true

userStories.title: fade init creates prds/ folder
acceptanceCriteria: Does not create prd.json in root (breaking change - optional)

userStories.title: fade upgrade command

acceptanceCriteria: fade upgrade compares prompt.md to latest template
